title: I tested whether changing who an argument is attributed to changes how LLMs evaluate the exact same argument [R]
summary: I’m the author of a new preprint looking at a fairly simple question: if the argument itself stays the same, does changing the claimed source change how an LLM evaluates it? I tested 20 arguments across 10 topics under four source conditions: relevant expert irrelevant expert non
reason: Post describes an author's preprint on LLM source-attribution bias, but the only link is a Reddit discussion thread, not the original paper/arXiv/official research artifact required by rule 2-1.
